newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Gulf Riyad Bank to liquidate Bahrain unit.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Riyad Bank to liquidate Bahrain unit.

text.p: Gulf Riyad Bank, a small Bahrain-based offshore banking unit (OBU), is liquidating its operations in Bahrain.
"We are liquidating Gulf Riyad Bank in Bahrain. It is going to be closed," a spokesman at the bank's liquidator, Ernst & Young, told Reuters.
Gulf Riyad Bank is 60 percent owned by Saudi Arabia's Riyad Bank and 40 percent by France's Credit Lyonnais.
An advertisement published in Bahraini newspapers said Gulf Riyad Bank's shareholders had decided at an extraordinary meeting on March 15 to liquidate the bank voluntarily.
It asked creditors to contact within a month Ernst & Young with any financial claim.
Bank officials were not available for comment.
